title: Patch: a Fuse that is attacked strikes back with its plain attack, since only its own attacks are multiplied
notes: R4156000: a sweeper that is attacked (Stinkyscape+ #107 Fuse) strikes back with its plain attack, 2 (Radiant 4), where it took its sweep's weight on that attacker (10 across its lane, 6 beside it; Radiant 28 and 16); only its own attacks carry the sweep's weight (R3554008). Combat, the combat forecast, My Pawn's First Strike projection and the AI's exchange read combat::strike_back_multiplier_for. The claimed play is the family classify's stage 2 names: its unforced games against the base build diverge on S+ #120 Crawler (stage 2 names the card whose actions diverge, not the Fuse that strikes back). Replays where a Fuse was attacked are refused as rules_changed (R767000).

player.title: Fuse hits back for its printed attack
fixes: Fuse hits back for its printed attack when it is attacked; only its own attacks are multiplied.
